data.narrative:
Phantom Space is a growth-stage company in Space & Aerospace founded by Jim Cantrell, Michael D'Angelo, and Michal Prywata. The valuation universe comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Sierra Space, Planet Labs, Impulse Space, and Apex Space.

Standard triangulation methods yield limited applicability here. Peer-median analysis is inapplicable: while 11 same-sector peers exist, zero meet both stage and valuation-tier filters simultaneously, falling short of the three-datapoint minimum required for reliable median anchoring. Public-comp P/S anchoring is similarly constrained by missing data—the public Space & Aerospace sector median is 23.9x across the 6-ticker universe, but Phantom Space's revenue is undisclosed, precluding multiple application. The private peer set is identifiable but lacks sufficient granular financial disclosures to support comparables-based valuation.

This analysis cannot support a quantitative valuation range without either: (1) disclosed revenue enabling public-multiple application, or (2) acquisition-price or financing-round data from same-stage Space & Aerospace companies. The core uncertainties are data transparency on target financials and scarcity of recent Stage-Growth transactions in the sector. Forward valuation work should prioritize obtaining revenue figures or identifying recent growth-stage funding rounds among the identified private peers to establish an empirical basis.
